ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This figure is a circular-arrow schematic diagram of the grasshopper life cycle. A points to a string of eggs, and C is marked beside the larger winged adult grasshopper above. Along the circular arrows from after the eggs to before the adult, there are several smaller grasshopper forms, respectively marked as F, B, G, E. Reasoning: Grasshoppers undergo incomplete metamorphosis, and the nymph stage is the immature individual from after hatching from the egg to before becoming an adult, with an appearance like a small adult but not yet a fully mature adult. Therefore exclude egg A and adult C, and the nymph stages in the figure correspond to F, B, G, E.
